# msl_events (Data Source)

Lists MSL5 **Events** (`/api/v1/streams/{stream_id}/events`) for a given stream.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) ID of the stream to list events for.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) List of events for the specified stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the event is currently active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `end_time` (String) RFC3339 end time.
- `ended` (Boolean) Whether the event has ended.
- `event_name` (String) Unique event name within the stream.
- `id` (String) Event ID (UUID).
- `start_time` (String) RFC3339 start time.
- `stream_id` (String) ID of the parent stream.
- `subsegment_clipping` (Boolean) Whether sub-segment clipping is enabled.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-updated timestamp.
